methods.name: public static FileLockTable newSharedFileLockTable(Channel channel, FileDescriptor fd) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Creates and returns a file lock table for a channel that is connected to
     * the a system-wide map of all file locks for the Java virtual machine.

methods.name: public abstract void add(FileLock fl) throws OverlappingFileLockException
methods.comment:
* Adds a file lock to the table.
     *
     * @throws OverlappingFileLockException if the file lock overlaps
     *         with an existing file lock in the table

methods.name: public abstract void remove(FileLock fl)
methods.comment: * Remove an existing file lock from the table.

methods.name: public abstract List<FileLock> removeAll()
methods.comment:
* Removes all file locks from the table.
     *
     * @return  The list of file locks removed

methods.name: public abstract void replace(FileLock fl1, FileLock fl2)
methods.comment: * Replaces an existing file lock in the table.
